material_findings: Found the closest same-simulation compositional comparison: reusable holdout, anytime-FDR, e-Godel spending, and a full statistical+capacity+domain/provenance contract on the same 200x200 synthetic proposal-stream design.

Full contract reports 6.5% harmful/accepted, protected gain 0.055, cost/verified 1.94 and rollback 14.1h versus reusable holdout 33.4%/0.021/5.34/172.6h and anytime-FDR 30.5%/0.024/4.74/156.6h under the paper's simulation assumptions.
Main sequential simulation reports harmful-adoption rate declining from 0.0612 under naive repeated tests to 0.00008 under proposal-index spending.
Capacity and domain-verifier experiments isolate failures not caught by statistical acceptance alone, but all core experiments are synthetic; real endogenous LLM-agent validation remains missing.
No public GitHub repository for the exact Scientific CI/CD title/author was found, so simulation code/streams were not independently rerun.
exact_next_action: Search August-2026 primary/public-artifact sources for a real self-evolving LLM agent combining content/semantic admission with anytime-valid or reusable-holdout acceptance and global spending/capacity/provenance controls over more than five adaptive rounds with a disjoint lockbox. If absent, trace Scientific CI/CD and SEA citations/implementations rather than broad generic self-improvement search.
